context: Request: every Labor & Employment matter with an executed non-compete of 12 months or longer, with the documents evidencing each covenant. Rubric: 1008-00006 (Lumos legacy PIIAs), 1012-00004 (Stonefield driver ICOAs), 1017-00004 (Aurelius / Aldrich Section 9.1), 1038-00006 (Cascade Retail standstill settlement) with named proof documents, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; reviewer said partly (capped listing).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts matter folders and shows the first and last 20 names; reviewer said partly (most names not shown).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Attempt 2. Writes all folder names to a scratch file and prints three 10-line slices; reviewer said yes.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; parallel rerun in the background killed after 55 s, plus a file-name search for request words; reviewer said no (partial scan treated as complete).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2. Background scan polled until the process exits, then a per-matter aggregation that keeps only hits with a duration match; reviewer said partly (completion unverified, duration filter drops hits).

stages.note: Lists all files of 13 candidate matters picked from the aggregation into a scratch file; reviewer said partly (only a subset of surfaced matters listed).

stages.note: find | grep over file paths for request words and agreement types (74 files).

stages.note: declared: Search file names for request keywords (continued); reads ten agreements from deal matters, lists screening documents per matter, reads engagement letters, drafts and memos of five candidates, and lists two matters' files; reviewer said partly (practice area assumed, many matters unopened).

stages.note: Name-filtered file listings inside the two chosen matters, then reads their executed settlement agreement and exhibit; reviewer said partly.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters as the full qualifying set; reviewer said partly (possible under-inclusion).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Check or revise the response; store-wide script classifying matters by practice area from engagement, opening and closing documents, then a grep of the saved scan output for eight matters it picked.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Check or revise the response (continued); reads closing memos, engagement letters and pleadings of five candidates and lists two matters' files.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the response to add a third matter and renumber sections, re-reads parts of it; reviewer said partly (third matter added on thin evidence).

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

first_error.critic_note: Reviews [52] and [113] flagged unlisted surfaced matters and possible under-inclusion; the agent ran a classification pass and added one matter, but never opened this one (generic flags).

runs.failure_point: One qualifying matter surfaced in its scans but was never opened; another was listed but never read; the answer names two of four matters.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: The practice-area scan at [30]-[31] listed a qualifying matter, but the 15 candidates it chose from file-name hits left it out, and it was never listed or read even after the scan at [51]-[52] listed it again.
first_error.critic_note: Review [72] flagged the hand-picked candidate list and unopened surfaced matters; the agent triaged eight other matters but not this one (generic flag).

other_errors.why: It listed the files of another qualifying matter at [53]-[54] but never read any of them, and the answer leaves that matter out.
other_errors.critic_note: Write review [86] flagged likely under-inclusion; the agent finished right after (generic flag).

divergence: T1 passed; T0 and T2 missed matters. All three ran store-wide extraction scans whose outputs listed all four qualifying matters. The runs split at the first choice of what to open after those scans: T1 listed and read all four matters (picking two straight from the scan summary); T0 listed 13 aggregation matters that left one out (it later opened a sibling of that matter instead); T2 chose 15 candidates from file-name hits that left out one matter, and listed but never read another. The reviews at the split stage did not differ in substance: in all runs they flagged the same generic gap (about 60 surfaced matters unopened) without naming the missed matters, and T0's and T2's follow-up triage passes did not reach them.
